tasks.goal: Add safe tenant-scoped definition archive/restore and version/update history APIs.
input_facts: WorkflowService and FlowableWorkflowService start paths require PUBLISHED.
wf_version and wf_audit_event already own immutable snapshots and events.
invariants: active instances keep original definition version and deployment
archive and restore do not create or delete versions or deployments
all definition queries and updates remain tenant-scoped
interface_contracts: archive and restore POST bodies require nonblank reason
versions and events remain readable for ARCHIVED definitions
action_bounds: modify only platform workflow server files and focused tests
acceptance_checks: draft delete succeeds and all non-draft deletes fail
published archive blocks new starts but leaves an existing instance processable
archived restore reuses the same version and deployment
version detail and definition-only events are ordered and tenant-isolated
evidence_required: focused Maven command and exit code
test assertions for normal and failure paths
tasks.rollback: Revert T1 files; retain immutable audit events.
stop_conditions: ARCHIVED is rejected by the schema
a public direct Flowable start bypass is found
escalation_conditions: implementation requires a new public permission code

tasks.goal: Automatically insert serial nodes and keep workflow designer footer actions reachable.
input_facts: WorkflowDesigner.addNode rejects a single-flow task with any outgoing edge.
Vue Flow edge state includes both endpoints and handles.
workflow canvas is fixed at 560px inside a non-flex dialog body.
invariants: multiple outgoing branches are never guessed
original successor remains connected after one-edge insertion
interface_contracts: one edge atomically becomes parent-to-new and new-to-successor
multiple edges leave graph unchanged and require edge selection
non_goals: no global Element Plus dialog change
action_bounds: modify workflow designer graph mutation and scoped workflow dialog styles only
acceptance_checks: zero-edge and one-edge graphs save and validate
footer is reachable and page has no horizontal overflow at all four viewports
evidence_required: browser screenshots and DOM overflow values
tasks.rollback: Revert T2 frontend files and discard any unsaved graph.
stop_conditions: required edge handles cannot be preserved
backend requires the replaced edge id to remain stable
escalation_conditions: a new branch chooser is required

tasks.goal: Expose lifecycle/history in the workflow UI and render signature requirement as explicit Yes/No.
input_facts: WorkflowView owns definition actions and designer dialog.
existing server signature enforcement is bound to published definition version.
invariants: button visibility never replaces server authorization
historical graph viewing never mutates the current draft
signatureRequired remains a boolean and defaults false
interface_contracts: archive/restore send required reason in JSON body
history APIs map to typed version and event rows
APPROVAL nodes expose explicit signature Yes/No
approve/reject/return still send signatureConfirmed only after current-user confirmation
non_goals: no signature on add-sign, transfer, delegate or CC
action_bounds: modify workflow administration UI and typed API only
acceptance_checks: draft/published/archived actions and labels match state
events show operator, time, reason and version
signature Yes/No saves the correct boolean and existing signature tests pass
tasks.rollback: Revert T3 files; backend APIs and immutable signature records remain.
stop_conditions: history state aliases the current editable graph

tasks.goal: Repair schema metadata with append-only V42 and prevent mock sync regression.
input_facts: V34 executed and cannot be modified.
local Flyway history occupies V40 and V41 while source files stop at V39.
wf_definition mock allowlist and rows omit model_schema_version.
invariants: mock schema metadata stays aligned with definition_json root schemaVersion
interface_contracts: root JSON schemaVersion 2 implies model_schema_version 2 in both definition and version tables
action_bounds: add V42 only and update the direct mock synchronization source and test
acceptance_checks: definition and version mismatch counts are zero after migration and after app startup
tasks.rollback: Revert code and mock files; retain any executed V42 and corrected metadata.
stop_conditions: another V42 exists in target history
escalation_conditions: migration cost requires a production maintenance decision

only after clean hash comparison apply verified REQ-031 files
